care.summary: Stunning red-tinted aglaonema with vibrant pink and green variegated foliage.
care.water: Water when top 2-3 cm soil is dry
common_issues: Brown leaf tips from low humidity or fluoride
Leggy growth in very low light
Faded color without sufficient indirect light
tips: Tolerates low light better than most colorful plants
Rotate pot monthly for even growth
Wipe leaves with damp cloth to maintain vibrant color
